import { receiptKey, validateReceiptFields, freezeReceipt } from '../success/Data.js';
export function decodeFailure(snapshot, identity) {
	if (
		!snapshot ||
		snapshot.input?.kind !== 'failure' ||
		!['failed', 'unknown'].includes(snapshot.input.writeState) ||
		receiptKey(snapshot.input) !== receiptKey(identity)
	)
		throw Error('Invalid failure receipt');
	for (const name of ['title', 'description', 'correlationId', 'returnTarget', 'nextTarget'])
		if (
			Reflect.get(snapshot.input, name) !== undefined &&
			typeof Reflect.get(snapshot.input, name) !== 'string'
		)
			throw Error('Invalid result text');
	for (const name of ['disabled', 'readonly'])
		if (
			Reflect.get(snapshot.input, name) !== undefined &&
			typeof Reflect.get(snapshot.input, name) !== 'boolean'
		)
			throw Error('Invalid result policy');
	validateReceiptFields(snapshot.receipt, identity);
	if (!Array.isArray(snapshot.reasons)) throw Error('Failure reasons missing');
	if (
		snapshot.input.writeState === 'failed' &&
		(snapshot.reasons.length !== 2 ||
			new Set(snapshot.reasons.map((reason) => reason.id)).size !== 2)
	)
		throw Error('Two distinct failure reasons required');
	for (const reason of snapshot.reasons)
		if (
			!['purpose', 'project'].includes(reason.id) ||
			(reason.target !== undefined &&
				reason.target !== (reason.id === 'purpose' ? 'draft-purpose' : 'draft-project')) ||
			typeof reason.title !== 'string' ||
			typeof reason.description !== 'string'
		)
			throw Error('Invalid reason target');
	const copy = structuredClone({
		...snapshot,
		reasons: snapshot.input.writeState === 'unknown' ? [] : snapshot.reasons
	});
	return freezeReceipt(copy);
}

import { computed, nextTick, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router';
import { AsamCard, AsamInput, AsamTextarea, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import ReceiptSummary from '../success/ReceiptSummary.vue';
import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'FailureDraftDestination' });

		fixture: { type: null, required: true },
		size: { type: String, required: false }

	route = useRoute(),
	i18n = useTemplateI18n(),
	element = ref(),
	text = (zh, en) => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh);
const workspace = computed(() => route.path === '/local/workspace'),
	title = computed(() =>
		workspace.value

			: text('修改本地申请草稿', 'Edit the local request draft')

onMounted(async () => {
	await nextTick();
	if (workspace.value || props.fixture.controls.disabled) return;
	const field = route.path === '/local/draft/project' ? 'project' : 'purpose';
	element.value
		?.querySelector(
			'[data-draft-field="' + field + '"] ' + (field === 'purpose' ? 'textarea' : 'input')

		?.focus();
});

				><ReceiptSummary :receipt="receipt" />
				<ol
					v-if="!unknown"
					class="failure-reasons"
					:aria-label="text('待处理问题', 'Issues to review')"
				>
					<li
						v-for="(reason, index) in reasons"
						:key="reason.id"
						:data-failure-reason="reason.id"
					>
						<span class="reason-index" aria-hidden="true">{{ index + 1 }}</span>
						<div>
							<h2>{{ reason.title }}</h2>
							<p>{{ reason.description }}</p>
						</div>
						<AsamLink
							v-if="reason.target && host.allows(reason.target)"
							class="failure-reason-link"
							type="primary"
							:href="'#' + reason.target"
							:aria-label="
								reason.title +
								' — ' +
								(reason.id === 'purpose'
									? text('去修改', 'Edit')
									: text('去确认', 'Confirm'))
							"
							:disabled="disabledActions || !!reasonPending"
							@click.prevent="locate(reason)"
							>{{
								reason.id === 'purpose'
									? text('去修改', 'Edit')
									: text('去确认', 'Confirm')
							}}</AsamLink
						>
					</li>
				</ol>
				<div class="verification-note" aria-live="polite">
					<p v-if="recovery.message.value">{{ recovery.message.value }}</p>
					<p v-if="recovery.notice.value">{{ recoveryNotice }}</p>
					<p v-if="navigationFeedback">{{ navigationFeedback }}</p>
					<AsamButton
						v-if="recovery.pending.value"
						:size="size"
						@click="recovery.cancel"
						type="primary"
						>{{ text('取消核验', 'Cancel verification') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</div></template
			></MinimalResultPage
		></AsamCard
	>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamCard, AsamLink, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import MinimalResultPage from '../families/MinimalResultPage.vue';
import { createResultController } from '../Controller.js';
import { receiptKey } from '../success/Data.js';
import ReceiptSummary from '../success/ReceiptSummary.vue';
import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
import { createBoundedRecovery } from './Recovery.js';
const props = defineProps({
	input: { type: Object, required: true },
	receipt: { type: Object, required: true },
	reasons: { type: Array, required: true },
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	verificationTimeoutMs: { type: Number, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	theme: { type: String, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['start', 'success', 'failure']),
	i18n = useTemplateI18n(),
	text = (zh, en) => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh);
const recovery = createBoundedRecovery(
	() => props.host.recovery,
	() => props.input,
	() => props.verificationTimeoutMs ?? 5000
);
const wrappedHost = computed(() => ({
	...props.host,
	recovery:
		props.input.writeState === 'unknown' && props.host.recovery
			? { operation: props.host.recovery.operation, run: recovery.run }
			: undefined
}));
const unknown = computed(() => props.input.writeState === 'unknown'),
	labels = computed(() => ({
		return: text('返回修改', 'Return to edit'),
		recover: text('核实原操作', 'Verify original operation')

	disabledActions = computed(
		() => !!props.input.disabled || !!props.input.readonly || recovery.pending.value
	);

	recovery.notice.value === 'timeout'
		? text(
				'核验已超时，原回执未改变；请显式重新核实。',
				'Verification timed out. The original receipt is unchanged; verify again explicitly.'
			)
		: recovery.notice.value === 'cancelled'
			? text(
					'核验已取消，原操作没有重新提交。',
					'Verification cancelled. The original operation was not resubmitted.'
				)
			: text(
					'核验读取失败，原回执未改变。',
					'The verification read failed. The original receipt is unchanged.'
				)
);
const reasonPending = shallowRef(''),
	navigationFeedback = shallowRef(''),
	controllers = new Set();
let alive = true;
let activeReasonController;
async function locate(reason) {
	const target = reason.target;
	if (
		!target ||
		!props.host.allows(target) ||
		disabledActions.value ||
		reasonPending.value ||
		unknown.value ||
		!props.reasons.includes(reason)
	)
		return;

		controller = createResultController({ ...props.input, returnTarget: target }, props.host);

	navigationFeedback.value = '';

		await controller.go('return');
	} catch {
		/* 原控制器已产生公开安全反馈，原始异常不展示。 */
	} finally {
		if (alive && activeReasonController === controller && receiptKey(props.input) === ownKey) {
			activeReasonController = undefined;
			navigationFeedback.value =
				controller.formatMessage?.(i18n) ?? controller.feedback.value.message;
			reasonPending.value = '';
		}

		controller.dispose();
	}

watch(
	[
		() => receiptKey(props.input),
		() => props.host,
		() => props.input.disabled,
		() => props.input.readonly
	],
	() => {
		activeReasonController = undefined;
		recovery.reset();
		for (const controller of controllers) controller.dispose();
		controllers.clear();
		reasonPending.value = '';
		navigationFeedback.value = '';
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);

	alive = false;
	activeReasonController = undefined;
	recovery.dispose();
	for (const controller of controllers) controller.dispose();
	controllers.clear();
});
</script>

import { computed, reactive, shallowRef, watch, nextTick } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory } from 'vue-router';
import { createNavigation } from '../navigation/Navigation.js';
import { receiptKey } from '../success/Data.js';
/** 仅本地合成adapter。真实导航仍由原032模块负责，没有业务提交服务。 */
export function createFailureFixture(locale, components) {
	const controls = reactive({
		owner: 'reader-a',
		scope: 'synthetic-east',
		revision: 1,
		mode: 'failed',
		delayMs: 80,
		verification: 'unknown',
		navigation: 'normal',
		readonly: false,
		disabled: false,
		denied: false,
		invalidId: false
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		reads: 0,
		verifications: 0,
		navigations: 0,
		aborted: 0,
		writes: 0,
		localEdits: 0,
		readerVersion: 1,
		actions: 0
	});
	const draft = reactive({ purpose: '', project: '' }),
		lastSnapshot = shallowRef(),
		destination = shallowRef(),
		initialized = shallowRef(false);
	let disposed = false,
		navEpoch = 0,
		activeNavigation;
	const timers = new Set();
	const identity = computed(() => ({
		id: controls.invalidId ? '' : 'synthetic-receipt-018',
		route: '/result/fail',
		owner: controls.owner,
		scope: controls.scope,
		revision: controls.revision
	}));
	const matches = (who) => {
		try {
			return !disposed && !controls.denied && receiptKey(who) === receiptKey(identity.value);
		} catch {
			return false;
		}
	};
	function wait(signal, ms) {
		return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			let done = false;
			const finish = (abort) => {
				if (done) return;
				done = true;
				clearTimeout(timer);
				signal.removeEventListener('abort', stop);
				timers.delete(stop);
				if (abort) {
					audit.aborted++;
					reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
				} else resolve();
			};
			const stop = () => finish(true),
				timer = setTimeout(() => finish(false), ms);
			timers.add(stop);
			if (signal.aborted || disposed) stop();
			else signal.addEventListener('abort', stop, { once: true });
		});
	}
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createMemoryHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/', redirect: '/result/fail' },
			{ path: '/result/fail', component: components.scene }
		]
	});
	const targetPaths = {
		workspace: '/local/workspace',
		draft: '/local/draft',
		'draft-purpose': '/local/draft/purpose',
		'draft-project': '/local/draft/project'
	};
	const navigation = createNavigation({
		router,
		scope: 'synthetic-failure-navigation',
		fallback: '/result/fail',
		components: { draft: components.destination },
		load: async () =>
			controls.denied
				? []
				: Object.entries(targetPaths).map(([id, path]) => ({
						id,
						path,
						title: id,
						resource: 'draft',
						cache: false
					})),
		confirm: async () => {
			const own = activeNavigation;
			await nextTick();
			return (
				!own ||
				(!own.context.signal.aborted &&
					own.ticket === navEpoch &&
					matches(own.context) &&
					!controls.readonly &&
					!controls.disabled &&
					controls.navigation !== 'cancel')
			);
		}
	});
	const services = shallowRef();
	function makeServices() {
		return {
			async read(request) {
				audit.reads++;
				const mode = controls.mode,
					t = (zh, en) => (request.locale === 'en' ? en : zh);
				await wait(request.signal, mode === 'timeout' ? 2000 : controls.delayMs);
				if (!request.isCurrent() || !matches(request))
					throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
				if (mode === 'error') throw Error('PRIVATE_FAILURE_READ_ERROR');
				if (mode === 'empty') return { status: 'empty' };
				const who = {
					id: request.id,
					route: request.route,
					owner: request.owner,
					scope: request.scope,
					revision: request.revision
				};
				const unknown = mode === 'unknown';
				const snapshot = {
					input: {
						...who,
						kind: 'failure',
						writeState: unknown ? 'unknown' : 'failed',
						title: unknown
							? t('提交结果待确认', 'Submission result unconfirmed')
							: t('提交未完成', 'Submission incomplete'),
						description: unknown
							? t(
									'响应尚未确认，请先核实原操作结果；没有重新提交。',
									'The response is unconfirmed. Verify the original operation; nothing has been resubmitted.'
								)
							: t(
									'请处理下列问题，再继续完成申请。本例未连接真实提交服务。',
									'Review these issues before continuing. This demo has no live submission service.'
								),
						returnTarget: 'draft'
					},
					receipt: {
						identity: who,
						subject:
							mode === 'long'
								? t(
										'研发测试设备采购及多团队长周期测试环境能力扩展项目',
										'Development testing equipment purchase and multi-team long-term environment expansion'
									)
								: t('研发测试设备采购', 'Development test equipment purchase'),
						number: 'SQ-20261030-018',
						applicant:
							who.owner === 'reader-a'
								? t('林岚', 'Lin Lan')
								: t('周远', 'Zhou Yuan'),
						amountCents: mode === 'partial' ? null : mode === 'zero' ? 0 : 2468000,
						provenance: 'synthetic'
					},
					reasons: unknown
						? []
						: [
								{
									id: 'purpose',
									title: t('请补充采购用途说明', 'Add the purchase purpose'),
									description: t(
										'说明设备使用场景，便于审批人判断。',
										'Describe the intended usage so the reviewer can assess the request.'
									),
									target: 'draft-purpose'
								},
								{
									id: 'project',
									title: t('请确认关联项目', 'Confirm the related project'),
									description: t(
										mode === 'long'
											? '关联项目暂不可修改。请保留当前草稿，向项目负责人核对申请归属与费用分摊，并等待项目资料恢复后再继续填写。'
											: '项目归属决定后续费用分摊。',
										mode === 'long'
											? 'The related project cannot currently be edited. Keep this draft and ask the project owner to confirm the allocation before continuing.'
											: 'The project determines how costs are allocated.'
									),
									...(mode === 'long' ? {} : { target: 'draft-project' })
								}
							]
				};
				lastSnapshot.value = snapshot;
				return { status: 'ready', snapshot };
			}
		};
	}
	services.value = makeServices();
	const resultHost = computed(() => {
		const verification = controls.verification;
		return {
			fallback: 'workspace',
			allows: (target) =>
				!disposed &&
				!controls.denied &&
				Object.hasOwn(targetPaths, target) &&
				navigation.menu.value.some((item) => item.id === target),
			async navigate(target, context) {
				if (
					!matches(context) ||
					context.signal.aborted ||
					controls.disabled ||
					controls.readonly ||
					router.currentRoute.value.path !== '/result/fail' ||
					!Object.hasOwn(targetPaths, target)
				)
					return false;
				const ticket = ++navEpoch;
				await wait(context.signal, controls.delayMs);
				if (
					!matches(context) ||
					context.signal.aborted ||
					ticket !== navEpoch ||
					controls.disabled ||
					controls.readonly
				)
					return false;
				if (controls.navigation === 'error')
					throw Error('PRIVATE_FAILURE_NAVIGATION_ERROR');
				if (controls.navigation === 'cancel') return false;
				activeNavigation = { ticket, context };
				destination.value = lastSnapshot.value;
				try {
					const accepted = await navigation.navigate(navigation.location(target));
					if (accepted && matches(context)) audit.navigations++;
					return accepted;
				} finally {
					if (activeNavigation?.ticket === ticket) activeNavigation = undefined;
				}
			},
			recovery: {
				operation: 'verify',
				async run(context) {
					audit.verifications++;
					await wait(
						context.signal,
						['late', 'timeout'].includes(verification) ? 2000 : controls.delayMs
					);
					if (
						!matches(context) ||
						context.signal.aborted ||
						controls.disabled ||
						controls.readonly
					)
						throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
					if (verification === 'error') throw Error('PRIVATE_FAILURE_VERIFICATION_ERROR');
					const t = (zh, en) => (locale() === 'en' ? en : zh);
					if (verification === 'denied') return { status: 'denied' };
					if (verification === 'confirmed')
						return {
							status: 'confirmed',
							message: t(
								'仅核实了原操作记录；当前失败回执没有改为成功。',
								'Only the original operation record was verified. This failure receipt has not become a success.'
							)
						};
					return {
						status: 'still-failed',
						message:
							verification === 'failed'
								? t(
										'原操作核验反馈为失败；原回执保留，可返回本地修改。',
										'Verification reports that the original operation failed. The receipt is retained; the local draft can be edited.'
									)
								: t(
										'原操作仍无法确认，请稍后再核实；没有重新提交。',
										'The original operation remains unconfirmed. Verify later; nothing has been resubmitted.'
									)
					};
				}
			}
		};
	});
	const readHost = computed(() => ({
		identity: identity.value,
		allowed:
			initialized.value &&
			!controls.denied &&
			router.currentRoute.value.path === '/result/fail',
		disabled: controls.disabled,
		readonly: controls.readonly,
		timeoutMs: controls.mode === 'timeout' ? 120 : 5000,
		verificationTimeoutMs: controls.verification === 'timeout' ? 120 : 5000,
		services: services.value,
		resultHost: resultHost.value
	}));
	const stop = watch(
		[
			() => controls.owner,
			() => controls.scope,
			() => controls.revision,
			() => controls.denied,
			() => controls.invalidId
		],
		() => {
			navEpoch++;
			activeNavigation = undefined;
			lastSnapshot.value = undefined;
			destination.value = undefined;
			draft.purpose = '';
			draft.project = '';
			if (initialized.value) {
				void router.replace('/result/fail');
				void navigation.reload(controls.scope);
			}
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	const stopMode = watch(
		() => controls.mode,
		() => controls.revision++,
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	return {
		controls,
		audit,
		draft,
		identity,
		readHost,
		resultHost,
		router,
		navigation,
		destination,
		update(key, value) {
			controls[key] = value;
		},
		actionStarted() {
			audit.actions++;
		},
		replaceReader() {
			audit.readerVersion++;
			services.value = makeServices();
			navEpoch++;
			activeNavigation = undefined;
			lastSnapshot.value = undefined;
			destination.value = undefined;
			draft.purpose = '';
			draft.project = '';
			if (initialized.value) void router.replace('/result/fail');
		},
		updateDraft(field, value) {

				controls.disabled ||
				!destination.value ||

		},
		async initialize() {
			await router.replace('/result/fail');
			await router.isReady();
			if (!(await navigation.reload())) throw Error('Local navigation not ready');
			initialized.value = true;
		},
		async back() {
			activeNavigation = undefined;
			await router.replace('/result/fail');
		},
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			stop();
			stopMode();
			navEpoch++;
			for (const stop of [...timers]) stop();
			navigation.dispose();
			lastSnapshot.value = undefined;
			destination.value = undefined;
		}
	};
}

import { shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { receiptKey } from '../success/Data.js';
/** 原ResultController仍拥有结果反馈；这里只界定一次只读服务的取消与等待时间。 */
export function createBoundedRecovery(getService, getInput, timeout) {
	const pending = shallowRef(false),
		notice = shallowRef(''),
		message = shallowRef('');
	let disposed = false,
		epoch = 0,
		abort;
	function cancel(reason) {
		epoch++;
		const own = abort;
		abort = undefined;
		own?.();
		pending.value = false;
		message.value = '';
		if (reason) notice.value = reason;
	}
	async function run(context) {
		cancel();
		notice.value = '';
		const own = ++epoch,
			service = getService(),
			key = receiptKey(context),
			controller = new AbortController();
		if (disposed || !service || context.signal.aborted || context.disabled || context.readonly)
			throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
		pending.value = true;
		const failure = { timedOut: false };
		const current = () =>
			!disposed &&
			own === epoch &&
			receiptKey(getInput()) === key &&
			getService() === service &&
			!getInput().disabled &&
			!getInput().readonly &&
			!context.signal.aborted;
		let rejectOwn;
		const stopped = new Promise((_resolve, reject) => {
			rejectOwn = () => {
				controller.abort();
				reject(new DOMException('Read cancelled', 'AbortError'));
			};
			abort = rejectOwn;
		});
		const onAbort = () => {
			cancel();
		};
		context.signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
		const deadline = Number.isFinite(timeout()) && timeout() > 0 ? timeout() : 5000;
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			failure.timedOut = true;
			controller.abort();
			rejectOwn?.();
		}, deadline);
		try {
			const response = await Promise.race([
				Promise.resolve().then(() => {
					if (!current()) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
					return service.run({ ...context, signal: controller.signal });
				}),
				stopped
			]);
			if (!current()) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
			if (!['confirmed', 'still-failed', 'denied'].includes(response.status))
				throw Error('Invalid verification result');
			message.value =
				'message' in response && typeof response.message === 'string'
					? response.message.slice(0, 240)
					: '';
			return response;
		} catch (error) {
			if (!disposed && own === epoch && receiptKey(getInput()) === key)
				notice.value = failure.timedOut
					? 'timeout'
					: controller.signal.aborted
						? 'cancelled'
						: 'read';
			throw error;
		} finally {
			if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
			context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
			if (abort === rejectOwn) abort = undefined;
			if (own === epoch) pending.value = false;
			controller.abort();
		}
	}
	return {
		pending,
		notice,
		message,
		run,
		cancel() {
			cancel('cancelled');
		},
		reset() {
			cancel();
			notice.value = '';
		},
		dispose() {
			disposed = true;
			cancel();
		}
	};
}

			><AsamButton

			v-else-if="input && snapshot && state.status.value === 'ready'"

			:host="fixture.resultHost.value"
			:verification-timeout-ms="fixture.readHost.value.verificationTimeoutMs"
			:theme="theme"
			:size="size"
			@start="fixture.actionStarted"

			:sub-title="statusDescription"

<script setup>
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamSkeleton, AsamResult } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
import { createReceiptReader } from '../success/Read.js';
import { decodeFailure } from './Data.js';
import FailureResultPage from './FailureResultPage.vue';
defineOptions({ name: 'FailureReceiptScene' });
const props = defineProps({
		fixture: { type: null, required: true },
		size: { type: String, required: false },
		theme: { type: String, required: false }
	}),
	i18n = useTemplateI18n(),
	text = (zh, en) => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh);
const state = createReceiptReader(
		() => props.fixture.readHost.value,
		() => i18n.locale.value,
		decodeFailure
	),
	input = state.input,
	snapshot = state.snapshot;
const statusTitle = computed(() =>
	state.status.value === 'forbidden'
		? text('无权读取回执', 'Receipt access denied')
		: state.status.value === 'empty'
			? text('暂无回执', 'No receipt')
			: state.status.value === 'error'
				? text('暂时无法读取回执', 'Receipt unavailable')
				: text('等待读取回执', 'Awaiting receipt read')
);
const statusDescription = computed(() =>
	state.error.value === 'timeout'
		? text(
				'读取已超时，原操作未改变，请显式刷新重试。',
				'The read timed out. The original operation is unchanged; refresh to retry.'
			)
		: state.error.value === 'invalid'
			? text(
					'回执身份或字段格式不匹配，没有展示原始数据。',
					'The receipt identity or field format does not match. No raw data is displayed.'
				)
			: text(
					'只读取当前合法宿主提供的回执，不推断写入是否完成。',
					'Only the current permitted receipt is read. No write completion is inferred.'
				)
);
onBeforeUnmount(state.dispose);
</script>

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
import Scene from './Scene.vue';
import Destination from './Destination.vue';
import { createFailureFixture } from './Fixture.js';
export async function mountFailResult(element, host, onError) {
	const locale = shallowRef('zh-CN'),
		i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value })),
		fixture = createFailureFixture(() => i18n.locale.value, {
			scene: Scene,
			destination: Destination
		});
	const app = createApp(App, {
		fixture,
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		diagnostics: host?.diagnostics,
		onLocale: (value) => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'failure-result-demo' });
	app.use(fixture.router);
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	try {
		await fixture.initialize();
		app.mount(element);
	} catch (error) {
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
		throw error;
	}
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

		class="result-page minimal-page"

		:data-theme="theme"
		:data-size="size ?? 'default'"
		data-family="minimal"
	>
		<header class="minimal-mast">
			<span class="result-wordmark">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.asamWorkspace') }}</span
			><span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.operationResult') }}</span>
		</header>
		<component
			:is="businessResult ? AsamCard : 'div'"
			v-bind="
				businessResult
					? {
							shadow: 'never',
							bordered: true,
							bodyStyle: { padding: 'var(--asam-space-xl, 24px)' }
						}
					: {}
			"
			class="minimal-body"
			><div
				v-if="!businessResult"
				class="minimal-index"
				:data-code="content.code"
				:data-kind="input.kind"
				aria-hidden="true"
			>
				{{ content.code }}
			</div>
			<component
				:is="panel"
				:title="title"
				:description="description"
				:tone="tone ?? content.tone"
				:actions="actions"
				:state-key="stateKey"
				:size="size"
				:readonly="input.readonly"
				:disabled="input.disabled"
				@start="start"
				@success="success"
				@failure="failure"
				class="result-content"
				><template v-if="!businessResult && !nativeIcon" #icon
					><span class="result-sr">{{ content.code }}</span></template
				><slot name="receipt" :input="input" />
				<div class="result-details">
					<p v-if="path" class="result-path">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.requestedPath') }} <bdi>{{ path }}</bdi>
					</p>
					<p v-if="correlation">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.correlationId') }}
						<bdi>{{ correlation }}</bdi>
					</p>
					<p v-if="input.kind === 'failure' && input.writeState === 'unknown'">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.theWriteResultIsUnknownVerifyIt') }}
					</p>
					<p class="result-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite">
						{{ feedback.message }}
					</p>
				</div></component
			></component
		>
		<footer class="minimal-foot">
			{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.everyStepHasAClearDestination')
			}}<span>ASAM WORKSPACE</span>
		</footer>
	</main>
</template>
<script setup>
import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
import { AsamCard } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
import { useResultPage } from '../useResultPage.js';
import { computed, nextTick, onScopeDispose, useSlots } from 'vue';
const props = defineProps({
	tone: { type: String, required: false },
	nativeIcon: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	actionLabels: { type: Object, required: false },
	primaryAction: { type: String, required: false },
	printReceipt: { type: Function, required: false },
	input: { type: Object, required: true },
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	theme: { type: String, required: false },
	verifyOnly: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const businessResult = computed(() => props.input.kind === 'success');
const slots = useSlots();
const emit = defineEmits(['start', 'success', 'failure']);
const {
	content,
	actions: navigationActions,
	panel,
	path,
	correlation,
	stateKey,
	feedback,
	start,
	success,
	failure
} = useResultPage(props, emit);
const title = computed(() =>
	businessResult.value && slots.receipt && props.input.title === undefined
		? i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSuccessTitle')
		: content.value.title
);
const description = computed(() =>
	businessResult.value && slots.receipt && props.input.description === undefined
		? i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSuccessDescription')
		: content.value.description
);
let active = true;
onScopeDispose(() => {
	active = false;
});
const actions = computed(() => {
	const ownState = stateKey.value;
	// 展示属性通过getter读取，避免文案/主色变化替换030仍在执行的动作。
	const existing = navigationActions.value.map((action) => ({
		id: action.id,
		run: action.run,
		get disabled() {
			return action.disabled;
		},
		get button() {
			return props.primaryAction === action.id
				? { type: 'primary', plain: false }
				: action.button;
		},
		get label() {
			return props.actionLabels?.[action.id] ?? action.label;
		}
	}));
	if (props.verifyOnly) return existing.filter((action) => action.id === 'recover');
	if (!businessResult.value || !slots.receipt) return existing;
	return [
		...existing
			.filter((action) => action.id === 'next')
			.map((action) => ({
				...action,
				button: { type: 'primary', plain: false },
				get label() {
					return i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptViewRequest');
				}
			})),
		{
			id: 'print-receipt',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptPrint');
			},
			run: async () => {
				await nextTick();
				if (
					active &&
					stateKey.value === ownState &&
					props.input.kind === 'success' &&
					props.input.confirmed &&
					!props.input.disabled &&
					!props.input.readonly
				)
					await (props.printReceipt ?? (() => window.print()))(
						Object.freeze({ ...props.input })
					);
			}
		},
		...existing.filter((action) => action.id !== 'next')
	];
});
</script>

export function receiptKey(value) {

			(item) => typeof item !== 'string' || !item.trim()

		throw Error('Invalid result kind');
	if (result.kind === 'success' && result.confirmed !== true)
		throw Error('Success must be explicitly confirmed');
	if (
		(result.kind === 'failure' || result.kind === 'server-error') &&
		!['unknown', 'failed'].includes(result.writeState)
	)
		throw Error('Unknown write state is required');

		throw Error('Invalid unknown route');

		if (Reflect.get(result, key) !== undefined && typeof Reflect.get(result, key) !== 'boolean')

			receipt.steps.filter((step) => step.state === 'current').length > 1

			if (

		if (status.value === 'loading') status.value = 'idle';
	}
	async function refresh() {
		cancel();
		snapshot.value = undefined;
		error.value = '';
		if (!canRead()) {
			status.value = getHost().allowed ? 'idle' : 'forbidden';
			return;
		}
		const host = getHost(),
			key = keyOfHost();
		if (!key) {
			status.value = 'error';
			error.value = 'invalid';
			return;
		}
		if (runtime.scope !== key) runtime.setScope(key);
		const own = ++generation,
			context = runtime.createContext();
		status.value = 'loading';
		const current = () =>
			!disposed &&
			own === generation &&
			getHost().allowed &&
			!getHost().disabled &&
			keyOfHost() === key &&
			getHost().services === host.services;
		const isCurrent = () => current() && runtime.isCurrent(context);
		let timeout,
			ownCancel,
			timedOut = false,
			decoding = false;
		try {
			const deadline =
				typeof host.timeoutMs === 'number' &&
				Number.isFinite(host.timeoutMs) &&
				host.timeoutMs > 0
					? host.timeoutMs
					: 5000;
			const aborted = new Promise((_resolve, reject) => {
				ownCancel = () => reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
				cancelPending = ownCancel;
			});
			const deadlineRead = new Promise((_resolve, reject) => {
				timeout = setTimeout(() => {
					timedOut = true;
					runtime.release(context);
					reject(Error('Receipt timeout'));
				}, deadline);
				timer = timeout;
			});
			const result = await Promise.race([
				Promise.resolve().then(() => {
					if (!isCurrent()) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
					return host.services.read({
						...host.identity,
						locale: locale(),
						signal: context.signal,
						isCurrent
					});
				}),
				deadlineRead,
				aborted
			]);
			if (!isCurrent()) return;
			if (result.status === 'ready') {
				decoding = true;
				snapshot.value = decode(result.snapshot, host.identity);
				status.value = 'ready';
			} else status.value = result.status;
		} catch {
			if (current()) {
				snapshot.value = undefined;
				status.value = 'error';
				error.value = timedOut ? 'timeout' : decoding ? 'invalid' : 'read';
			}
		} finally {
			if (timeout) clearTimeout(timeout);
			if (timer === timeout) timer = undefined;
			if (cancelPending === ownCancel) cancelPending = undefined;
			runtime.release(context);
		}
	}
	const stop = watch(
		[
			() => getHost().identity.id,
			() => getHost().identity.route,
			() => getHost().identity.owner,
			() => getHost().identity.scope,
			() => getHost().identity.revision,
			() => getHost().services,
			() => getHost().allowed,
			locale
		],
		() => {
			cancel();
			snapshot.value = undefined;
			status.value = getHost().allowed ? 'idle' : 'forbidden';
			if (canRead()) void refresh();
		},
		{ flush: 'sync', immediate: true }
	);
	const stopDisabled = watch(
		() => getHost().disabled,
		(value) => {
			if (value) cancel();
			else if (!snapshot.value && canRead()) void refresh();
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	const input = computed(() =>
		snapshot.value
			? {
					...snapshot.value.input,
					disabled: !!getHost().disabled || !!snapshot.value.input.disabled,
					readonly: !!getHost().readonly || !!snapshot.value.input.readonly
				}
			: undefined
	);
	return {
		snapshot,
		status,
		error,
		input,
		canRead: computed(canRead),
		refresh,
		cancel,
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			stop();
			stopDisabled();
			cancel();
			snapshot.value = undefined;
		}
	};
}

	}),

import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { computed, nextTick, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamException, AsamStatePanel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createResultController } from './Controller.js';
export function useResultPage(props, emit = () => {}) {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	const copy = computed(() => ({
		success: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.submissionComplete'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theHostConfirmedTheResultViewTheRecordOr'),
			code: i18n.t('app.templates.results.complete'),
			tone: 'success'
		},
		failure: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theOperationDidNotComplete'),
			description: i18n.t(
				'app.templates.results.verifyTheLatestResultBeforeDecidingWhatToDo'
			),
			code: i18n.t('app.templates.results.needsAttention'),
			tone: 'warning'
		},
		forbidden: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.thisPageIsCurrentlyUnavailableToYou'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.youDoNotHaveAccessToThisResourceRead'),
			code: '403',
			tone: 'warning'
		},
		'not-found': {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.pageNotFound'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theAddressMayHaveChangedCheckThePathOr'),
			code: '404',
			tone: 'info'
		},
		'server-error': {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theServiceIsTemporarilyUnavailable'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.noResultWasReceivedReadTheStatusAgainOr'),
			code: '500',
			tone: 'error'
		}
	}));
	const controller = createResultController(props.input, props.host);
	// 只跟随 030 公开事件固定 actions 身份，按钮 pending/disabled/aria-busy 仍全部由 030 管理。
	const executing = shallowRef(false);
	const generation = shallowRef(0);
	let disposed = false;
	const stateKey = computed(() =>
		JSON.stringify([
			props.input.id,
			props.input.kind,
			props.input.route,
			props.input.owner,
			props.input.scope,
			props.input.revision,
			props.input.disabled,
			props.input.readonly
		])
	);
	watch(
		() => [stateKey.value, props.input, props.host],
		() => {
			generation.value++;
			executing.value = false;
			controller.replace(props.input, props.host);
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	onScopeDispose(() => {
		disposed = true;
		generation.value++;
		controller.dispose();
	});
	function start(id) {
		executing.value = true;
		emit('start', id);
	}
	function success(id) {
		// 此时 030 已完成本次执行。先释放，再通知宿主，允许回调同步启动下一次动作。
		executing.value = false;
		emit('success', id);
	}
	function failure(id, error) {
		executing.value = false;
		emit('failure', id, error);
	}
	const verified = computed(
		() => props.input.kind !== 'success' || props.input.confirmed === true
	);
	const content = computed(() => ({
		...copy.value[props.input.kind],
		title: verified.value
			? props.input.title || copy.value[props.input.kind].title
			: i18n.t('app.templates.results.resultNotYetConfirmed'),
		description: verified.value
			? props.input.description || copy.value[props.input.kind].description
			: i18n.t('app.templates.results.waitForTheHostToConfirmTheBusinessResult'),
		tone: verified.value ? copy.value[props.input.kind].tone : 'info'
	}));
	const actions = computed((previous) => {
		const own = generation.value;
		// feedback 已结算不代表 030 的 await 已结算；直到其真实终结事件才更新动作列表。
		if (executing.value && previous) return previous;
		const run = (action) => async () => {
			// start 回调可以同步替换输入/卸载；先让 Vue 提交这些变更，再核本动作身份。
			await nextTick();
			if (!disposed && own === generation.value) await action();
		};
		const list = [];
		if (
			props.host.recovery &&
			['failure', 'server-error', 'forbidden'].includes(props.input.kind)
		)
			list.push({
				id: 'recover',
				get label() {
					return props.input.kind === 'forbidden'
						? i18n.t('app.templates.results.readPermissionsAgain')
						: i18n.t('app.templates.results.verifyAgain');
				},
				run: run(controller.recover)
			});
		if (
			props.input.nextTarget &&
			props.host.allows(props.input.nextTarget) &&
			((props.input.kind === 'success' && verified.value) ||
				(['failure', 'server-error'].includes(props.input.kind) &&
					controller.feedback.value.phase === 'confirmed'))
		)
			list.push({
				id: 'next',
				get label() {
					return i18n.t('app.templates.results.viewRecord');
				},
				run: run(() => controller.go('next'))
			});
		list.push({
			id: 'return',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.results.returnToWorkspace');
			},
			run: run(() => controller.go('return'))
		});
		return list;
	});
	const panel = computed(() => (props.input.kind === 'success' ? AsamStatePanel : AsamException));
	const path = computed(() =>
		props.input.kind === 'not-found' ? props.input.unknownPath.slice(0, 160) : ''
	);
	const correlation = computed(() => props.input.correlationId?.slice(0, 80) || '');
	return {
		content,
		actions,
		panel,
		path,
		correlation,
		stateKey,
		feedback: computed(() => ({
			...controller.feedback.value,
			message: controller.formatMessage?.(i18n) ?? controller.feedback.value.message
		})),
		start,
		success,
		failure
	};
}

失败结果页区分明确失败与原操作结果未知。同一份回执提供事项、编号、申请人、金额及两条原因；去修改/去确认与返回修改进入已登记的本地字段目标。

核验与安全返回

unknown只核实原操作，不重发、不改为成功。核验支持pending、取消、超时、未明、明确失败与拒绝；身份、scope、revision、读取器、权限或卸载改变时隔离迟到响应。原结果控制器管理反馈与动作，页面没有第二套业务写状态机。

修改目标是本地合成草稿，可实际编辑用途与项目但没有提交服务。原因字段、回执和目标保持同一对象与身份。只读/禁用阻止动作，切换身份清除旧草稿。打印不属于本页动作，原结果三族和默认打印保持。

源码与工程

TS/JS展示复制、源码ZIP、正常工程ZIP与实际运行同源。正常固定包/锁/补丁随工程提供；JS checkJs=false。共享成功页输入为明确未验内部依赖，不是已验前置。无真实业务API或重复提交。
